text:
violet: Quick experiment idea: make SDK sampling route-prioritized so expensive endpoints (e.g., embeddings, long-gen) get higher sample weight. This should improve quota/cost dashboards. Want feedback on contract & rollout.

marc: Is this header-only? Or do we change payloads?

violet: header-only. plan: add a tiny versioned handshake + hint header. Example:

X-RD-SAMPLE-V: 1
X-RD-SAMPLE-HINT: route=embed;mode=prefer

kevin: Server must accept legacy flag too. Also we should support a "hint-only" server mode that logs hints but doesn't alter sampling so telemetry can validate parity first.

nina: Strong :+1: for parity. Console needs a normalization view (raw vs normalized) so PMs/CS don't misinterpret changes. We'll need a nightly job to emit both metrics for 10-14d.

opsbot: FYI incident-1822 referenced: header casing broke route attribution previously. Add header-casing tests for py/ts/go.

marc: SDK release plan: minor opt-in across py/ts/go using env var REDWOOD_SDK_SAMPLING=route-aware. No default flips in a patch.

violet: Agreed. rollout idea:
1) server "hint-only" logging for 7d on canary infra
2) SDKs release opt-in minor with handshake header + startup log when enabled
3) small tenant canary toggle in console showing raw vs normalized charts
4) nightly telemetry parity job (emit raw & normalized) for 14d
5) only consider default flip in next major after parity window

kevin: Add negotiation version header so proxies can safely fallback. Also add integration matrix: py39/py311, node18, go1.20 + linux/mac.

nina: I'll own the console QA and the parity job spec. Also will add a button to overlay normalized series on existing charts.

release-bot: ticket created: RW-9201 (sdk-route-sampling) and PR stub rw/sdk-config#518.

marc: docs: include FAQ for "why charts moved" and quick rollback env var `REDWOOD_SDK_SAMPLING=off`. Also supply KQL snippets for support.

violet: I'll open the opt-in PR and test matrix. target: draft PR by Thu, matrix Fri, canary Sat. Posting link when ready. Thanks all.
